competences.description: Rapidly fires 2 shots, and may fire an additional shot by chance. The chance of firing an additional shot is equivalent to your Critical Rate.

effets.description: Attacks an additional time on the same turn.

competences.description: Attacks random enemies for 4 times. Each attack has a 75% chance to deal Continuous Damage for 2 turns. Decreases the cooldown time of [Arrow Storm] by 1 turn whenever you attack an enemy under Continuous Damage.

effets.description: The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)
Reduces cool down counter of skills by 1 or more
effets.note: If attacked enemy was under Continuous Damage

competences.description: Lays down supportive fire for allies under attack 3 times and inflicts Continuous Damage for 1 turn. Supportive Fire deals damage based on your Attack Power to enemies that attack your allies. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: When attacked, the target will counterattack to inflict 75% of the Attack Power as damage.
The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)
